Hero_Desc_Aragnia:
Aragnia was born in the depths of the Fickle Sea.
Perhaps because she lived alone in an underwater Pearl Kingdom, she is somewhat inexperienced at interacting with other Apostles.
However, as she spends time with everyone in Elias, she is gradually learning and growing.
Album_Like_Aragnia: The Master, and no one else
Album_Hate_Aragnia: Anything the Master dislikes, anything that harms the Master
Album_Hobby_Aragnia: Reclaiming the sea (building a kingdom in the ocean with sand she makes herself)
Album_Wish_Aragnia: To make the Pearl Kingdom the strongest nation in Elias together with the Master
Album_Aragnia1: Aragnia showed intense wariness toward Daya. Apparently, the role of the beautiful and strongest belongs squarely to her, and her copyright has been infringed? I should arrange an opportunity for them to get acquainted someday.
Album_Aragnia2: A health checkup at Hilde's hospital found nothing wrong with her. If anything, eating the mineral from which she originated every day and constantly moving while building her island seems to have kept her healthier than the average Dragon. Aragnia proudly declared that she truly was the strongest queen, apparently receiving an unexpected boost to her self-esteem.
Album_Aragnia3: I worried that she might be lonely living by herself on the coast, but fortunately Butter, Kommy, and Delia often visit and play with her. I was concerned after they witnessed her shocking method of producing sand, but they apparently became friends again while swimming together. Not that Aragnia seems aware she shocked them in the first place...
Album_Aragnia4: Aragnia is interested not only in the Apostles, but also in all the new things Elias has to offer. I worried she might become addicted to internet cafes like Ayla, but fortunately she seems to prefer books. Recently, she proudly told me that Kommy had recommended all sorts of books to her.
Album_Aragnia5: This time, she visited Elemental Lake as well. Having lived in the sea, she was curious about a freshwater lake, but found the bland water and earthy smell rather strange. She says it is a nice place, apart from Naia being too much to handle. So even Aragnia cannot deal with Naia...
Album_Aragnia6: Recently, Aragnia asked me where Sist had gone. She said Sist was a Dragon who showed her many fascinating things, and she was disappointed that Sist no longer came around. Curious about what had happened, I asked Sist, who replied that she had assumed a queen would be rich, but quit doing business with her after discovering she was not. Aragnia, you have been dropped as a customer...
Album_Aragnia7: Aragnia said she does not particularly miss the place where she used to live. The time she spent there after meeting me remains a fond memory, but she is far happier now in Elias. I worried that she might long for the past at least a little, but it seems my concern was unfounded. I am glad Aragnia is happy.
LoveHero_Aragnia: Hehe, it seems you require my aid.
LoveHeroCancel_Aragnia: Very well. I shall spend the meantime building my kingdom. Call upon me again when the time comes.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Hate1: She says the ambiguous flavor, neither warm nor cool, offends her sensibilities. It seems she dislikes anything that is neither one thing nor the other.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Hate2: She happily ate it because its round shape looked like a pearl, only to become angry and demand to know what that flavor was. Her teary eyes suggest she felt terribly wronged.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like1: She says its sparkle is beautiful and is delighted that gemstones are occasionally mixed in. It is a trap for everyone else, but apparently a surprise gift for Aragnia.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like10: She asked for more so she could share it with the citizens of the Pearl Kingdom. When I asked whether the kingdom had gained new citizens, she gave an inscrutable smile, gathered up an armful, and left the banquet hall.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like2: She says the dry, rough texture is delightful because it feels like chewing coral sand. Is that not usually the opposite of a compliment...?
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like3: Fascinated by the unfamiliar texture, she chewed every bite thoroughly. After closing her eyes to savor it, she ordered another bowl.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like4: She lavished praise on the wonderfully soft, sweet flavor, so different from its hard-looking exterior.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like5: At first, the tartness made her pull a curious face and eat it in tiny dips. Once she declared herself accustomed to it, she tossed the whole thing into her mouth. Her adaptability is truly remarkable.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like6: She liked how every new color and flavor gave her something to look forward to with the next bite.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like7: She liked it as a snack that could be eaten elegantly. Although she said it was perfect for eating one at a time, she promptly ate a whole handful, so she must have loved it.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like8: She says building a kingdom is bound to be exhausting at times, and food like this is very helpful then. She took away an enormous refill.
Food_ChefNote_Aragnia_Like9: She asked who had made such excellent candy, saying the chef deserved a royal commendation. When I wrote down the address so she could visit in person, she ran off excitedly.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Aragnia: At last, you have found me.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Aragnia: The strongest Pearl Queen shall stand beside you.
Aragnia_Spawn1: The strongest Pearl Queen has arrived.
Aragnia_Growth: I am Aragnia, Queen of the Pearl Kingdom.
Aragnia_Growth1: There are no limits before me.
Aragnia_Growth2: A queen must always refine her bearing.
Aragnia_Victory1: There is no shame in losing to the strong.
Aragnia_Victory2: Did you see that, my Master?
Aragnia_Defeat1: Why would I, the strongest, lose...?
Aragnia_Affinity1_1: A queen must always continue to refine herself.
Aragnia_Affinity1_2: You continue to stare. Am I truly so beautiful?
Aragnia_Affinity2: May I open a waterway from the Pearl Kingdom to the Order? Traveling back and forth is most difficult.
Aragnia_Affinity1_3: I do not yearn for the past. The long wait and my meeting with you are beautiful memories kept within my heart.
Aragnia_Affinity3: Rather than visit the dragon caves, simply come to my kingdom. I too am a dragon, and surely a beautiful shore is better than life underground.
Aragnia_Affinity4: With you and me together, there is nothing in the world to fear!
Aragnia_Affinity5: Being the strongest is well and good, but more than that, I wish to be a queen who makes you proud.
Aragnia_Affinity6: Life in Elias is delightful. It feels as though you and I share the same world.
Aragnia_Affinity7: My dear. My Master. Thank you... truly, for finding me.
Aragnia_HeroSkill: I have gained yet another measure of elegance.
Aragnia_HeroUpgrade: Behold to your heart's content the greatness of this Pearl Queen!
Aragnia_Board: Shall I expand my territory in this direction?
Aragnia_DeckSetting1: I shall show you the Pearl Kingdom's true might.
Aragnia_DeckSetting2: You require the Queen's power? It cannot be helped.
Aragnia_Touch1_2: I endure this only because it is you!
Aragnia_Touch2_2: You alone may treat me this way. Understood?
Aragnia_DutchRubEnd2: My dear! Is that not too cruel?!
Item_HeroSkin_Aragnia_Skin1: Transfer Student from the Blue Sea
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Aragnia_Skin1: A mysterious transfer student rises from the deep sea. And so begins Ara-chan's school life.
Aragnia_Growth1_Skin1: From this day forth, this school is Ara's kingdom.
Aragnia_Growth2_Skin1: Is this uniform not truly lovely?
Aragnia_HeroSkill_Skin1: Oh my, have I not become even prettier?
Aragnia_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Will I now have a junior too?
Aragnia_Touch1_Skin1: Ow! You will ruin my makeup!
Aragnia_Touch1_2_Skin1: I was not even late today!
Aragnia_Touch2_1_Skin1: As a special privilege, I permit you to call me little Ara.
Aragnia_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Waaah! Why would you hit little Ara?!
Aside_Get_Aragnia1: I have realized what it means to be special exactly as one is.
Aside_Upgrade_Aragnia1: A queen need not strive to be special. She already shines simply by being herself.
Aragnia_AsideGet: I have realized what it means to be special exactly as one is.
Aragnia_AsideUpgrade: A queen need not become special. She already shines merely by being herself.
Aragnia_Ultimate1: Every one of you shall sink!
Aragnia_Shout5: Be swept away by the tide!
Aragnia_Sorry2: All of this is due to my lack of virtue.
Aragnia_Birthday: My Master, happy birthday. May today's memories become a shining pearl within your heart.
Aragnia_Gacha2: The strongest Pearl Queen shall accompany you!
Aragnia_Gacha3: At last, you have found me.
Aragnia_Greeting: I am pleased to see you.
Aragnia_Line1: Welcome the strongest queen of the Pearl Kingdom!
Aragnia_Line2: Never forget that what is truly special is you yourself.
Aragnia_Line3: I am the one who releases tears and dreams of smiles, your very queen.
Aragnia_Lobby: Shall we seek another beautiful coral forest today?
LoveLetter_Aragnia:
My Master, it is wonderful to see you!
Every day has brought something new since I arrived in Elias at your side.
The years I spent guarding my tiny kingdom alone have begun to fade from memory.
Yet I cannot easily forget the moment we watched the morning sun rise together.
Though my kingdom was swept away, I look forward to seeing a new world rise!
My Master, let us continue welcoming each radiant new day together.
LoveCall_Aragnia:
Can you hear me, my dear?
The ways of communicating in Elias are convenient, yet difficult to master.
You happened to cross my mind, so I called.

Ever since I followed you to Elias, every moment has filled my heart with excitement and wonder!
After seeing the vast world of Elias, I realized anew what a frog in a well I had been, confined to that tiny island.
Hehe, a frog in a well. Do you not find it a charming expression? I learned it after coming here.
Yesterday, today, and tomorrow, I shall continue learning new things and dreaming new dreams.

Until even you cannot help but swell with pride at this strongest of Pearl Queens.
And until my Pearl Kingdom grows magnificent enough to be worthy of you.

My dear. My Master.
I sincerely pray that my existence may become a shining pearl to you,
and that having me beside you may lend you strength...
I shall end the call here.
I expect to be busy expanding the kingdom's territory again today!
If you wish to hear this queen's voice, you may contact me at any time.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP01_001: I am preparing a notice to recruit subjects for the Sacred Pearl Kingdom. What qualities should I focus on?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP01_003: That sounds reasonable. It is another virtue every subject should possess.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP01_005: Exactly! The strongest Queen must be followed by the strongest subjects!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP01_007: I-Is cuteness considered the greatest strength in this land...?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP02_001: I have brought a new tribute from the Elves' city!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP02_002: Did you pick up another strange book?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP02_003: It is not strange! It is a worthy tribute that will deepen my knowledge of Elias!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP02_004: You did not steal it, did you?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP02_005: H-Hmm? It caught my eye, so I simply took it... Was I supposed to pay something for it?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP02_007: I was told it can preserve a voice for a very long time. Would you record your voice in it?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_001: To think so much delicious food existed... Remembering all those years I ate nothing but pearls nearly moved me to tears.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_002: Did you not say your tears had sunk into the sea?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_003: I said I 'nearly' cried! I held them back!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_004: I will make sure you get to eat plenty from now on.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_005: Master... How can your heart be so warm? I am deeply moved!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_006: People sometimes cry from happiness too.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP03_007: That... had not occurred to me. Such tears must be rather precious.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP04_001: Master, what kind of people are the Dragons?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP04_003: Hehe, I knew it! In that case, I will gladly be a Dragon as well!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP04_004: Are you not already a Dragon?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP04_005: Now that you mention it, I have heard others look at me and whisper that I resemble one.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP04_006: You could say they enjoy establishing ranks.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP04_007: Hmm... I have no interest in rankings. It is only natural that I am the strongest!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP05_001: Master, who do you believe is the strongest Queen presently living in Elias?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP05_003: The Fairy Queen...? Is raw power your only measure of strength?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP05_005: Hmm... From what I have heard, she seems to be quite an admirable Queen. I am rather curious about her.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP05_007: Hehe. A perfect answer! From this day forward, I am the strongest Queen in Elias!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_001: Ever since I came to Elias, every day has been a sea of laughter!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_002: You will not be lonely anymore.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_003: Master, you alone are enough for me. Even if you were my sole subject, my heart would still be full!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_004: It would be nice if there were only laughter...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_005: What do you mean? Are there wicked scoundrels like pirates in this land as well?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_006: I hope only enjoyable things await you.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP06_007: I no longer fear tomorrow. I look forward to it. Will you walk beside me?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP07_001: Just as I treasure my jewels, is there something you wish to protect, Master?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP07_002: That question gives me a lot to think about.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP07_003: Master, have you protected even more things than I have? How commendable.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP07_005: Just as my kingdom is precious to me, Elias is precious to you. We truly are alike!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP07_006: I would not go that far...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP07_007: Why are you so lacking in confidence? Have you not realized how special you are?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_001: I saw the Elves gathering great piles of pearls and selling them...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_002: Those pearls must be too precious to eat...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_003: Indeed. One look at the price was enough to ruin my appetite...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_004: Even so, the pearl you showed me was the prettiest.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_005: Hehe. I agree. The deeper something is buried beyond our memories, the more vividly it returns to us.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_006: Some are fake, so do not let your guard down.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP08_007: T-There are fakes as well? Those Elves... How dare they conduct fraudulent trade with pearls!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP09_001: I met a glittering Dragon who called herself the leader of the Dragons.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP09_003: She said she was the Diamond Dragon... She appeared quite dignified and sturdy.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP09_004: You two must have a great deal in common.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP09_005: Our manner of speech is merely a little similar! It is you and I who are alike, Master!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP09_006: What does it matter? You are a Queen!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP09_007: You are very wise. No mere leader, no matter who she may be, can compare to the strongest Queen!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_001: I had only ever walked along sandy shores, so setting foot upon ground with such an unfamiliar texture felt strange.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_002: Do your feet even touch the ground?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_003: O-Of course they do! Ah, now that I consider it, is this a foot or a tail...?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_004: Let us take a walk through the forest together next time.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_005: The blades of grass do tickle... but anywhere is wonderful when I am with you!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_006: Be careful not to hurt yourself.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP10_007: Master, my dear subject! How admirable of you to look after your Queen's well-being.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP11_001: I am deciding upon a specialty product for my kingdom. What do you think would be best?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP11_003: Coral is material for expanding our territory... I will have to reserve a separate supply.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP11_004: Would pearls not be the obvious choice?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP11_005: Hmm. They are beautiful and rare jewels, so that seems suitable.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP11_006: When the kingdom already has you, does it truly need another specialty?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP11_007: Ahaha! Your eye is as discerning as ever! You are absolutely right!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP12_001: I am planning an outing. Where do you think I should go?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP12_003: A fine idea. It has been some time since I last saw Butter, Komi, and Delia.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP12_004: The Fairy Kingdom is still the best place for sightseeing.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP12_005: That is where you live. The bread and cakes are delicious too... It sounds wonderful.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP12_006: Let us decide together. I will come to the Pearl Kingdom.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP12_007: Truly? Wonderful! Anywhere will please me as long as you are there!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_001: Lately, far too many tributes from the Elves have been washing ashore. It troubles me.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_002: ...I will speak to Elena. I will tell her to send a reasonable amount of better things.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_003: Oh! Is this a diplomatic negotiation? My Master truly is exceptionally capable!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_004: That is not tribute. It is garbage.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_005: Eek! I told you it is not! Those are tributes the Elves offer to me!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_006: Why not keep only the useful things and send the rest back?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP13_007: That is a fine idea. I was worried about the Elven city's finances, so they should welcome it too.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP14_001: When my kingdom is complete, I intend to build a library first.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP14_003: Reading is my favorite pastime. Each book makes me feel as though I have set out upon a journey.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP14_004: Then will you let me provide the first book?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP14_005: Of course! I could read a book gifted by you any number of times and never tire of it!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP14_006: Books do not fare well in sea air. Will that be all right?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP14_007: I-Is that so? I had not considered that far...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_001: I have thought this for some time, but you never seem willing to rest.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_002: I want to lie upon warm sand and take a nap...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_003: Then my kingdom is the perfect place! Come and rest whenever you wish!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_004: I really want a vacation too...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_005: Is the Order's work truly so difficult? I worry for your health...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_006: No matter how much I finish, the work keeps piling up...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP15_007: Is that not far too cruel? I must have a word with the High Priest.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP16_001: There were pearls in Elemental Lake as well. I found it fascinating that pearls could exist somewhere other than the sea.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP16_002: Are you thinking of taking some?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP16_003: They belong to Elemental Lake. I am not an evil Queen who plunders another land's specialties.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP16_005: They were delicious! They were richer than sea pearls and had a distinctive aroma.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP16_006: Do you often visit Elemental Lake?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP16_007: Not... often. The Elementals there are so noisy that I feel drained whenever I visit.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_001: I like how calm and peaceful the seas of Elias are.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_002: Um... Was your old sea not like that too?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_003: Only because I deliberately stabilized its currents. By now, violent waves must be raging there.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_004: Please take good care of the sea.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_005: Of course! The sea is my domain, and I will tend it with the utmost care.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_006: I am glad you like the sea here.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP17_007: Hehe. Is it not a sea you gifted to me? How could I possibly dislike it?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_001: I traveled far out to sea in search of coral this time, so I am tired.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_002: Did you not say there was a coral forest in the nearby sea?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_003: Harvesting from only one place would leave the sea barren. It is proper to take everything in moderation.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_004: You are like a gardener of the sea, Aragnia.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_005: A gardener... I like the sound of that. I do tend the sea, so it is not inaccurate!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_006: Do not push yourself too hard. Your health matters most.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP18_007: Oh my... How can your heart be so kind? I feel as though my own heart might melt.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_001: I think the Sacred Pearl Kingdom should have a Guardian Tree of its own. What do you think?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_002: A tree upon the white sands... It would look beautiful.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_003: Your anticipation makes my heart race. I want to plant it as soon as possible!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_004: Can a tree grow in sand made from coral?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_005: Hmm? Is not any soil suitable? That is a problem I had not anticipated...
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_006: Then we should first find a tree capable of withstanding the sea wind.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP19_007: Oh, there are trees especially suited to that? You truly are knowledgeable.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP20_001: My Master, is there a wish you desire to fulfill?
Affinity_Aragnia_EP20_002: That is a difficult question... I do not think I can answer it easily.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP20_003: The journey to discover one's desire is arduous. I sincerely hope you find a good answer.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP20_005: Your wish for peace is truly admirable. You are indeed a subject of whom I can be proud!
Affinity_Aragnia_EP20_006: It changes from moment to moment, but right now I wish for you to settle in well here.
Affinity_Aragnia_EP20_007: You are always thinking of me. I will cherish that warm heart of yours.
